Checked against the real agent in busy-session-hook-delivery-qa-1: with real Rex and real Claude Code, the pointer returned this way showed up once in the transcript as hook_additional_context on PostToolUse:Bash, and the agent read the message file and acted on it mid-task. fields.statement: Yes: Claude Code adds a PostToolUse hook's additional context to the agent's context before its next step. The hook prints {"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"<text>"}} on stdout, and only for the PostToolUse event; other events return nothing.
